tranche.accountingScope: Lifetime actual work survives release, reset and restart, including cancelled gate work and replay calculations. Register counters describe its current backend history; replay does not add committed logical gate credit. Amplitude writes and tensor products are source-level work units, not FLOPS or physical quantum operations.
tranche.scope: One selected coherent register of up to 298 logical qubits, with each coherent joint factor limited to 59 qubits. Tensor factors retain entanglement. Global dense-state bounds are not allocated arrays. Logical gate calls and actual amplitude work are separate from the procedural family and from physical quantum gates.

circuit.memoryAccountingScope: Combined estimated retained coherent output and working shot state, including backend transactional work. Managed GC retention and other host memory are reported separately by the backend.
circuit.scope: Selected 1..298-qubit coherent circuits, simulated with classical FP64 arithmetic and seeded Born sampling. Registers of at most 29 qubits independently replay every shot. Wider registers prepare once and draw independent joint Z-basis samples from coherent factors. No physical quantum hardware or whole-family gate execution is claimed.

inputs.scope: Original UTF-8 and binary PDF source data with preserved SHA256. Preview and compilation do not execute. Explicit import selects a circuit; q.input run executes a validated program or command sequence with native job barriers. q.input table inspects CSV measurements; q.input fit performs a bounded empirical linear regression only after explicit target/features selection.

Entanglement can give a mixed local state. An exact zero vector has no preferred direction; a nonzero vector below tolerance retains its components and is labelled near-maximally mixed.

coherentSpinPreview.scope: Actual reduced Pauli expectations for the first at most four qubits of the retained coherent circuit output before independent measurement shots. Each queried coherent factor has at most 65536 stored entries. Omitted qubits were not evaluated and are not assigned zero vectors. This capture is separate from the saved procedural model and from postmeasurement shot states.
coherentSpinPreview.verificationScope: These are actual circuit-state calculations. The procedural-model q.verify CPU/GPU sampling gate does not independently verify these circuit snapshots.

result.bitOrder: Most significant displayed bit at left; qubit 0 at right.
result.scope: Full joint bitstrings from independently replayed coherent registers and sequential collapsing Born measurements. Histograms contain completed shots only; partial shot work and consumed random draws are counted separately.

result.memoryAccountingScope: Combined estimated retained coherent output and working shot state, including backend transactional work. Managed GC retention and other host memory are reported separately by the backend.

result.samplingScope: Each independent shot prepares, replays and measures a fresh coherent register in qubit order. One additional coherent execution is retained before measurement. Counters record actual replay and collapsing-measurement work.
